summary: Bootstrap seeds the initial Epic title via `.plate` `epic_naming_pattern` (default `Epic: initial-plate-epic`), names skipped template paths in apply output (capped list), and `gh plate health` audits SPEC from the remote default branch when local SPEC.md is absent (#1267 items 2, 4, 5).
migration_impact: No config migration. Re-run bootstrap is unchanged aside from clearer copy output; existing repos keep their Epic titles. Health may report SPEC audit status instead of false missing when SPEC.md exists only on GitHub.
agent_notes: Item 1 (squash commits) and item 3 (Epic milestone) are out of scope here; milestone landed in #1273.
